questions.question: Bash is still sandboxed on this host, so I cannot run `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6` and the post-write verification stays owed. How should I proceed?

options.label: I'll disable the bash sandbox — retry after that
options.description: Set [sandbox] bash = "off" in config.toml or Settings → Sandbox; I'll then run the od command and show the real byte output.

options.label: Run the od command yourself and paste it
options.description: You run it; I'll compare the output against the edit and report the result.

options.label: Accept the file read-back as verification
options.description: No shell proof; the change is confirmed only by read_file (retries=3 followed by timeout=30).
